newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil markets closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil markets closed for holiday.

text.p: Malaysian crude palm oil futures, physicals and palm kernel oil futures markets are closed on Wednesday for the New Year holiday.

On Tuesday, the markets closed the last trading session of the year higher after supportive export data prompted a recouping of early losses. The earlier fall was due to overnight losses in Chicago soyoil futures, traders said.
March futures closed nine ringgit higher at 1,255 ringgit ($496.64) a tonne. Traders said the next resistance will be 1,255 ringgit with strong support at the 1,235 level.
